effect.name: Fluid Warp
effect.desc: Warps the layer along a pseudo-fluid flow field combining an emitter direction, curl of fBm noise (vorticity/turbulence), gravity/buoyancy, viscosity damping, and swirl. This is a single-pass displacement, not a true fluid simulation; extras include dual-color tinting, blur-based shading, bloom, and Normal/Add/Screen blending.
